Container.Name: Dipolar App
Container.Overview: Dipolar web UI. Pulls from GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io). React app + nginx; proxies /api to Dipolar Server. Open the Web UI port (default 3000) in your browser.
Container.Description: Web UI for Dipolar (Streamio IPTV). Image is published to ghcr.io—no local build needed. Requires Dipolar Server running (Host network, port 3333). This container uses Bridge and reaches the API at host.docker.internal:3333. Leave Extra Parameters as set by the template.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Host port 3000 (browser); container port must be 80 (nginx).
